import { afterAll, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import worker, { composeLicenseWorkerV1 } from "../src/worker/compose.js";
import {
  decryptTotpSecretV1,
  encryptTotpSecretV1,
  hashPasswordPbkdf2V1,
  verifyPasswordPbkdf2V1,
  verifyTotpStepV1,
  createNeonAdminAdapterV1,
  type PgDriverV1,
} from "../src/adapters/neon_admin.js";
import { createNeonSignupAdapterV1 } from "../src/adapters/neon_signup.js";
import type { PgQueryV1 } from "../src/db/repository.js";
import { canonicalLicenseSnapshotV1 } from "../src/entitlement/decision.js";
import { applyMigrationsV1 } from "../scripts/apply_migrations.mjs";

const forbiddenCredential = "synthetic-credential-never-echo-9137";
const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;
const networkFetch = vi.fn(async () => {
  throw new Error("unexpected real network request");
});
vi.stubGlobal("fetch", networkFetch);

type DbRow = Record<string, unknown>;
interface DbEvent {
  readonly sql: string;
  readonly params: readonly unknown[];
  readonly transactionId: number | null;
}

class MemoryPgDriver implements PgDriverV1 {
  events: DbEvent[] = [];
  audits: unknown[][] = [];
  organizations: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
  users: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
  subscriptions: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
  revisions: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
  sessions: Array<{ tokenDigest: unknown; orgId: unknown; userId: unknown;
    deviceId: unknown; issuedAt: unknown; expiresAt: unknown; kind: string;
    sessionId: unknown; revokedAt: unknown }> = [];
  devices: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
  enrollments = new Map<string, { org_id: string; user_id: string;
    device_id: string; expires_at_utc_ns: string; confirmed_at_utc_ns: string | null }>();
  eventIds = new Set<string>();
  pending: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
  owner: DbRow | null = null;
  deviceActive = true;
  subscription: DbRow = {
    subscription_id: "lic_acceptance_001", revision: "7", status: "ACTIVE",
    term_start_utc_ns: "1700000000000000000", term_end_utc_ns: "2000000000000000000",
    features: { desktop_app: true }, limits: { api_rate_limit_rps: "10" },
  };
  failAudit = false;
  commits = 0;
  rollbacks = 0;
  private nextTransactionId = 1;
  private activeTransaction: number | null = null;

  async query<Row>(sql: string, params: readonly unknown[] = []): Promise<{ rows: Row[] }> {
    return this.execute<Row>(sql, params, null);
  }

  async transaction<T>(work: (tx: PgQueryV1) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    const snapshot = {
      audits: structuredClone(this.audits), sessions: structuredClone(this.sessions),
      enrollments: structuredClone(this.enrollments), eventIds: structuredClone(this.eventIds),
      pending: structuredClone(this.pending), owner: structuredClone(this.owner),
      organizations: structuredClone(this.organizations), users: structuredClone(this.users),
      subscriptions: structuredClone(this.subscriptions), revisions: structuredClone(this.revisions),
      devices: structuredClone(this.devices),
    };
    const transactionId = this.nextTransactionId++;
    this.activeTransaction = transactionId;
    try {
      const result = await work({ query: <Row>(sql: string, params: readonly unknown[]) =>
        this.execute<Row>(sql, params, transactionId) });
      this.commits += 1;
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      this.audits = snapshot.audits;
      this.sessions = snapshot.sessions;
      this.enrollments = snapshot.enrollments;
      this.eventIds = snapshot.eventIds;
      this.pending = snapshot.pending;
      this.owner = snapshot.owner;
      this.organizations = snapshot.organizations;
      this.users = snapshot.users;
      this.subscriptions = snapshot.subscriptions;
      this.revisions = snapshot.revisions;
      this.devices = snapshot.devices;
      this.rollbacks += 1;
      throw error;
    } finally {
      this.activeTransaction = null;
    }
  }

  private async execute<Row>(sql: string, params: readonly unknown[], transactionId: number | null): Promise<{ rows: Row[] }> {
    this.events.push({ sql, params: structuredClone(params), transactionId });
    const normalized = sql.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().toUpperCase();
    if (normalized.includes("INSERT INTO LICENSING_AUDIT_EVENTS") && this.failAudit) {
      throw new Error("synthetic audit insert failure");
    }
    let rows: DbRow[] = [];
    if (normalized.startsWith("INSERT INTO LICENSING_ORGANIZATIONS")) {
      const organization = { org_id: String(params[0]), active: params[1], display_name: params[2] ?? null };
      this.organizations.push(organization);
      if (normalized.includes("RETURNING")) rows = [organization];
    } else if (normalized.startsWith("INSERT INTO LICENSING_USERS")) {
      const user = { org_id: params[0], user_id: params[1], email: params[2], role_id: "owner",
        password_hash_pbkdf2: null, active: true, owner: true, totp_enrolled: false,
        created_at_utc_ns: params[3] };
      this.users.push(user);
    } else if (normalized.startsWith("INSERT INTO LICENSING_DEVICES")) {
      this.devices.push({ device_id: params[0], org_id: params[1], user_id: params[2], status: "ACTIVE" });
    } else if (normalized.startsWith("INSERT INTO LICENSING_SUBSCRIPTIONS")) {
      this.subscriptions.push({ org_id: params[0], subscription_id: params[1], revision: "1",
        status: params[2] ?? "ACTIVE", term_start_utc_ns: "1700000000000000000",
        term_end_utc_ns: "2000000000000000000", seat_limit: "10" });
      if (normalized.includes("RETURNING")) rows = [{ revision: "1" }];
    } else if (normalized.startsWith("INSERT INTO LICENSING_SUBSCRIPTION_REVISIONS")) {
      const sourceEvent = String(params[10]);
      if (this.eventIds.has(sourceEvent)) throw new Error("synthetic unique source event violation");
      this.eventIds.add(sourceEvent);
      this.revisions.push({ source_event_id: sourceEvent, params: [...params] });
    } else if (normalized.includes("FROM LICENSING_USERS") && normalized.includes("USER_ID=$1")
        && normalized.includes("LOWER(EMAIL)")) {
      if (this.owner && this.owner.user_id === params[0]
          && String(this.owner.email).toLowerCase() === String(params[1]).toLowerCase()) {
        rows = [structuredClone(this.owner)];
      }
    } else if (normalized.includes("FROM LICENSING_USERS") && normalized.includes("LOWER(EMAIL)")) {
      if (this.owner && this.owner.email === String(params[0]).toLowerCase()) rows = [structuredClone(this.owner)];
    } else if (normalized.includes("FROM LICENSING_USERS") && normalized.includes("USER_ID=$2")) {
      if (this.owner && this.owner.org_id === params[0] && this.owner.user_id === params[1]) rows = [structuredClone(this.owner)];
    } else if (normalized.includes("FROM LICENSING_USERS") && normalized.includes("USER_ID=$1")) {
      if (this.owner && this.owner.user_id === params[0]) rows = [structuredClone(this.owner)];
    } else if (normalized.includes("FROM LICENSING_DEVICES") && normalized.includes("JOIN LICENSING_ORGANIZATIONS")) {
      if (this.deviceActive && this.subscription.status === "ACTIVE"
          && this.owner?.org_id === params[1] && this.subscription.subscription_id === params[2]) rows = [{ active: 1 }];
    } else if (normalized.includes("FROM LICENSING_DEVICES")) {
      if (this.deviceActive && this.owner?.org_id === params[0] && this.owner?.user_id === params[1]
          && this.owner?.device_id === params[2]) rows = [{ active: 1 }];
    } else if (normalized.includes("FROM LICENSING_SUBSCRIPTIONS")) {
      if (this.owner?.org_id === params[0] || normalized.includes("JOIN LICENSING_ORGANIZATIONS")
          || this.subscriptions.some((item) => item.org_id === params[0])) {
        rows = [structuredClone(this.subscription)];
      }
    } else if (normalized.includes("FROM LICENSING_ADMIN_SESSIONS") && normalized.includes("SESSION_KIND='TOTP_ENROLLMENT'")) {
      const session = this.sessions.find((item) => item.tokenDigest === params[0] && item.kind === "TOTP_ENROLLMENT");
      if (session && session.revokedAt === null) rows = [{ org_id: session.orgId, user_id: session.userId, device_id: session.deviceId,
        expires_at_utc_ns: String(session.expiresAt), session_id: session.sessionId }];
    } else if (normalized.includes("FROM LICENSING_TOTP_ENROLLMENTS")) {
      const enrollment = this.enrollments.get(String(params[0]));
      if (enrollment && enrollment.confirmed_at_utc_ns === null) rows = [structuredClone(enrollment)];
    } else if (normalized.startsWith("UPDATE LICENSING_USERS SET TOTP_SECRET_CIPHERTEXT")) {
      if (this.owner && this.owner.totp_enrolled === false && this.owner.totp_secret_ciphertext == null) {
        this.owner.totp_secret_ciphertext = params[2];
        rows = [{ user_id: this.owner.user_id }];
      }
    } else if (normalized.startsWith("UPDATE LICENSING_USERS SET TOTP_ENROLLED=TRUE")) {
      if (this.owner) {
        this.owner.totp_enrolled = true;
        this.owner.totp_last_step = params[2];
        rows = [{ user_id: this.owner.user_id }];
      }
    } else if (normalized.startsWith("UPDATE LICENSING_USERS SET TOTP_LAST_STEP")) {
      if (this.owner && (this.owner.totp_last_step == null
          || BigInt(String(this.owner.totp_last_step)) < BigInt(String(params[2])))) {
        this.owner.totp_last_step = params[2];
        rows = [{ user_id: this.owner.user_id }];
      }
    } else if (normalized.startsWith("INSERT INTO LICENSING_ADMIN_SESSIONS")) {
      const kindMatch = /'((?:ADMIN|USER|TOTP_ENROLLMENT))'/.exec(normalized);
      this.sessions.push({ tokenDigest: params[1], orgId: params[2], userId: params[3],
        deviceId: params[4], issuedAt: params[5], expiresAt: params[6], kind: kindMatch?.[1] ?? "ADMIN",
        sessionId: params[0], revokedAt: null });
    } else if (normalized.startsWith("UPDATE LICENSING_ADMIN_SESSIONS SET REVOKED_AT_UTC_NS")) {
      const session = this.sessions.find((item) => item.sessionId === params[0]);
      if (session) session.revokedAt = params[1];
      rows = session ? [{ session_id: params[0] }] : [];
    } else if (normalized.startsWith("INSERT INTO LICENSING_TOTP_ENROLLMENTS")) {
      this.enrollments.set(String(params[0]), { org_id: String(params[1]), user_id: String(params[2]),
        device_id: String(params[3]), expires_at_utc_ns: String(params[4]), confirmed_at_utc_ns: null });
    } else if (normalized.startsWith("UPDATE LICENSING_TOTP_ENROLLMENTS")) {
      const enrollment = this.enrollments.get(String(params[0]));
      if (enrollment) enrollment.confirmed_at_utc_ns = String(params[1]);
    } else if (normalized.startsWith("INSERT INTO LICENSING_AUDIT_EVENTS")) {
      this.audits.push([...params]);
    } else if (normalized.startsWith("INSERT INTO LICENSING_PENDING_SIGNUPS")) {
      this.pending.push({ pending_account_id: params[0], org_id: params[1], owner_email: params[2],
        owner_user_id: params[3], device_id: params[4], status: "PENDING", idempotency_key: params[5] });
    } else if (normalized.includes("FROM LICENSING_PENDING_SIGNUPS")) {
      const pending = this.pending.find((item) => item.pending_account_id === params[0]);
      if (pending) rows = [structuredClone(pending)];
    } else if (normalized.includes("FROM LICENSING_SUBSCRIPTION_REVISIONS")
        && normalized.includes("SOURCE_EVENT_ID")) {
      if (this.eventIds.has(String(params[0]))) rows = [{ exists: 1 }];
    }
    return { rows: rows as Row[] };
  }
}

function base32(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  const alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567";
  let accumulator = 0;
  let bits = 0;
  let result = "";
  for (const byte of bytes) {
    accumulator = (accumulator << 8) | byte;
    bits += 8;
    while (bits >= 5) {
      bits -= 5;
      result += alphabet[(accumulator >> bits) & 31];
    }
  }
  if (bits > 0) result += alphabet[(accumulator << (5 - bits)) & 31];
  return result;
}

async function hotp(secretBase32: string, counter: bigint): Promise<string> {
  const alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567";
  let accumulator = 0;
  let bits = 0;
  const seed: number[] = [];
  for (const char of secretBase32) {
    accumulator = (accumulator << 5) | alphabet.indexOf(char);
    bits += 5;
    if (bits >= 8) {
      bits -= 8;
      seed.push((accumulator >> bits) & 255);
    }
  }
  const message = new Uint8Array(8);
  let value = counter;
  for (let index = 7; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
    message[index] = Number(value & 255n);
    value >>= 8n;
  }
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey("raw", new Uint8Array(seed),
    { name: "HMAC", hash: "SHA-1" }, false, ["sign"]);
  const digest = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign("HMAC", key, message));
  const offset = digest[digest.length - 1]! & 15;
  const binary = ((digest[offset]! & 127) << 24) | (digest[offset + 1]! << 16)
    | (digest[offset + 2]! << 8) | digest[offset + 3]!;
  return String(binary % 1_000_000).padStart(6, "0");
}

async function body(response: Response): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  return JSON.parse(await response.text()) as Record<string, unknown>;
}

function base64(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...bytes));
}

function jsonRequest(path: string, method: string, value: unknown, headers: Record<string, string> = {}): Request {
  return new Request(`https://worker.example${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", ...headers },
    body: JSON.stringify(value),
  });
}

function installOwner(driver: MemoryPgDriver, passwordHash: string, extra: Partial<DbRow> = {}): void {
  driver.owner = {
    org_id: "org-acceptance", user_id: "user-acceptance", email: "owner@example.test",
    password_hash_pbkdf2: passwordHash, active: true, owner: true, device_id: "device-acceptance",
    totp_enrolled: false, totp_secret_ciphertext: null, totp_last_step: null,
    ...extra,
  };
}

function decodeB64Url(value: string): Uint8Array {
  const normalized = value.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");
  return Uint8Array.from(atob(normalized + "=".repeat((4 - normalized.length % 4) % 4)), (char) => char.charCodeAt(0));
}

function decodeJsonB64Url(value: string): Record<string, unknown> {
  return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(decodeB64Url(value))) as Record<string, unknown>;
}

async function configuredBindings(): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
  const keys = await crypto.subtle.generateKey({ name: "ECDSA", namedCurve: "P-256" }, true,
    ["sign", "verify"]);
  const privateKey = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.exportKey("pkcs8", keys.privateKey));
  const publicJwk = await crypto.subtle.exportKey("jwk", keys.publicKey);
  return {
    DATABASE_URL: "postgres://synthetic_user:synthetic_pass@localhost:5432/licensing_test",
    STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: "sk_test_synthetic_compose_001",
    STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: "whsec_synthetic_compose_001",
    STRIPE_PRICE_ID: "price_syntheticcompose001",
    SIGNUP_SUCCESS_URL: "https://product.example.test/success",
    SIGNUP_CANCEL_URL: "https://product.example.test/cancel",
    ADMIN_SESSION_TTL_S: "600",
    USER_SESSION_TTL_S: "600",
    CAPS_APPROVED: "false",
    LICENSE_SIGNING_KEY_ID: "key_compose_acceptance",
    LICENSE_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PKCS8: base64(privateKey),
    LICENSE_VERIFY_PUBLIC_KEY_JWK: JSON.stringify(publicJwk),
    INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN: "synthetic-internal-service-token-001",
    ADMIN_TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY: base64(new Uint8Array(32).fill(9)),
  };
}

const routeCases: Array<{ path: string; method: string }> = [
  { path: "/v1/admin/license", method: "GET" },
  { path: "/v1/auth/introspect", method: "POST" },
  { path: "/v1/admin/accounts", method: "GET" },
  { path: "/v1/signup/checkout", method: "POST" },
  { path: "/v1/signup/webhook", method: "POST" },
  { path: "/v1/auth/session", method: "POST" },
  { path: "/v1/auth/session/totp/enroll", method: "POST" },
  { path: "/v1/auth/session/totp/confirm", method: "POST" },
  { path: "/v1/auth/session", method: "DELETE" },
  { path: "/v1/internal/device-entitlement/verify", method: "POST" },
];

function requestFor(path: string, method: string): Request {
  return new Request(`https://worker.example${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: method === "GET" || method === "DELETE"
      ? undefined : { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: method === "GET" || method === "DELETE" ? undefined : "{}",
  });
}

afterAll(() => {
  expect(networkFetch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  expect(forbiddenCredential).not.toContain(" ");
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  expect(globalThis.fetch).toBe(originalFetch);
});

describe("LIC-WORKER-COMPOSE-001 independent acceptance", () => {
  it("imports the default Worker and fails every route closed when bindings are absent", async () => {
    for (const route of routeCases) {
      const response = await worker.fetch(requestFor(route.path, route.method), {});
      expect(response.status, route.path).toBe(503);
      expect((await body(response)).error).toMatchObject({ code: "NOT_CONFIGURED" });
      expect(response.headers.get("cache-control")).toMatch(/no-store/i);
    }
  });

  it("returns NOT_CONFIGURED on every route if any required binding is absent", async () => {
    const complete = await configuredBindings();
    const required = Object.keys(complete);
    for (const missingName of required) {
      const env = { ...complete };
      delete env[missingName];
      const composed = await composeLicenseWorkerV1(env);
      for (const route of routeCases) {
        const response = await composed.fetch(requestFor(route.path, route.method));
        expect(response.status, `${missingName} / ${route.path}`).toBe(503);
        expect((await body(response)).error).toMatchObject({ code: "NOT_CONFIGURED" });
      }
    }
  });

  it("fails closed for malformed public JWK or private PKCS8 at composition time", async () => {
    const complete = await configuredBindings();
    for (const [field, value] of [
      ["LICENSE_VERIFY_PUBLIC_KEY_JWK", "{"],
      ["LICENSE_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PKCS8", "bm90LWEtcGtleQ=="],
    ] as const) {
      const env = { ...complete, [field]: value };
      const composed = await composeLicenseWorkerV1(env);
      const response = await composed.fetch(requestFor("/v1/auth/session", "POST"));
      expect(response.status).toBe(503);
      expect((await body(response)).error).toMatchObject({ code: "NOT_CONFIGURED" });
    }
  });

  it("uses bounded PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256 credentials with a 16-byte random salt", async () => {
    const encoded = await hashPasswordPbkdf2V1(forbiddenCredential);
    const parts = encoded.split("$");
    expect(parts).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(parts[0]).toBe("pbkdf2-sha256");
    expect(Number(parts[1])).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(600_000);
    expect(atob(parts[2]!).length).toBe(16);
    expect(atob(parts[3]!).length).toBe(32);
    expect(await verifyPasswordPbkdf2V1(forbiddenCredential, encoded)).toBe(true);
    expect(await verifyPasswordPbkdf2V1("synthetic-wrong-password-9137", encoded)).toBe(false);
    expect(await verifyPasswordPbkdf2V1(forbiddenCredential, null)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("encrypts TOTP seeds at rest and binds decryption to org and user AAD", async () => {
    const seed = base32(new TextEncoder().encode("12345678901234567890"));
    const encryptionKey = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(32).fill(7)));
    const ciphertext = await encryptTotpSecretV1(seed, encryptionKey, "org_acceptance", "user_acceptance");
    expect(ciphertext).toMatch(/^aes256gcm\$[A-Za-z0-9+/]+=*\$[A-Za-z0-9+/]+=*$/);
    const [, iv, encrypted] = ciphertext.split("$");
    expect(atob(iv!).length).toBe(12);
    expect(atob(encrypted!).length).toBeGreaterThan(20);
    expect(ciphertext).not.toContain(seed);
    expect(await decryptTotpSecretV1(ciphertext, encryptionKey, "org_acceptance", "user_acceptance"))
      .toBe(seed);
    await expect(decryptTotpSecretV1(ciphertext, encryptionKey, "other_org", "user_acceptance"))
      .rejects.toThrow();
    await expect(decryptTotpSecretV1(ciphertext, encryptionKey, "org_acceptance", "other_user"))
      .rejects.toThrow();
  });

  it("checks RFC 6238 SHA-1 30-second steps, one-step skew, and replay rejection", async () => {
    const seed = "GEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQGEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQ";
    expect(await hotp(seed, 1n)).toBe("287082");
    expect(await verifyTotpStepV1(seed, await hotp(seed, 0n), 30, null)).toBe(0n);
    expect(await verifyTotpStepV1(seed, await hotp(seed, 1n), 59, null)).toBe(1n);
    expect(await verifyTotpStepV1(seed, await hotp(seed, 2n), 30, null)).toBe(2n);
    expect(await verifyTotpStepV1(seed, await hotp(seed, 3n), 30, null)).toBeNull();
    expect(await verifyTotpStepV1(seed, await hotp(seed, 1n), 59, 1n)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("dispatches each configured route family through its handler using only fake ports", async () => {
    const env = await configuredBindings();
    const driver = new MemoryPgDriver();
    const fakeFetch = vi.fn(async () => new Response("{}", { status: 500 }));
    const composed = await composeLicenseWorkerV1(env, { driver, fetch: fakeFetch });
    const probes = [
      { path: "/v1/admin/license", method: "GET", body: undefined, expected: 401 },
      { path: "/v1/auth/introspect", method: "POST", body: {}, expected: 401 },
      { path: "/v1/admin/accounts", method: "GET", body: undefined, expected: 401 },
      { path: "/v1/signup/checkout", method: "POST", body: {}, expected: 400 },
      { path: "/v1/signup/webhook", method: "POST", body: {}, expected: 400 },
      { path: "/v1/auth/session", method: "POST", body: {}, expected: 400 },
      { path: "/v1/auth/session/totp/enroll", method: "POST", body: {}, expected: 400 },
      { path: "/v1/auth/session/totp/confirm", method: "POST", body: {}, expected: 400 },
      { path: "/v1/auth/session", method: "DELETE", body: {}, expected: 401 },
      { path: "/v1/internal/device-entitlement/verify", method: "POST", body: {}, expected: 403 },
    ];
    for (const probe of probes) {
      const request = probe.method === "GET"
        ? new Request(`https://worker.example${probe.path}`, { method: probe.method })
        : jsonRequest(probe.path, probe.method, probe.body);
      const response = await composed.fetch(request);
      expect(response.status, probe.path).toBe(probe.expected);
      expect((await body(response)).error?.code).not.toBe("NOT_FOUND");
    }
    expect(fakeFetch).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("delegates nested admin account and session paths to the Admin API envelope", async () => {
    const env = await configuredBindings();
    const composed = await composeLicenseWorkerV1(env, { driver: new MemoryPgDriver(), fetch: vi.fn() });
    const probes = [
      { path: "/v1/admin/accounts/org-acceptance/subscriptions", method: "GET", body: undefined,
        status: 401, code: "UNAUTHENTICATED" },
      { path: "/v1/admin/session/opaque-token", method: "DELETE", body: undefined,
        status: 404, code: "NOT_FOUND" },
      { path: "/v1/admin/session/enrollment/confirm", method: "POST", body: {},
        status: 400, code: "INVALID_REQUEST" },
    ] as const;
    for (const probe of probes) {
      const request = probe.method === "GET" || probe.method === "DELETE"
        ? new Request(`https://worker.example${probe.path}`, { method: probe.method })
        : jsonRequest(probe.path, probe.method, probe.body);
      const response = await composed.fetch(request);
      const value = await body(response);
      expect(response.status, probe.path).toBe(probe.status);
      expect(value.error?.code, probe.path).toBe(probe.code);
      expect(value).toHaveProperty("request_id");
      expect(value.code).toBeUndefined();
    }
  });

  it("returns one-time TOTP enrollment only for an active un-enrolled admin owner and rejects confirmation replay", async () => {
    const env = await configuredBindings();
    const driver = new MemoryPgDriver();
    const password = "correct horse battery staple";
    installOwner(driver, await hashPasswordPbkdf2V1(password));
    const composed = await composeLicenseWorkerV1(env, { driver, fetch: vi.fn() });
    const login = (pass: string) => jsonRequest("/v1/admin/session", "POST", {
      owner_email: "owner@example.test", password: pass, device_id: "device-acceptance",
    });

    const wrongPassword = await composed.fetch(login("incorrect password for owner"));
    expect(wrongPassword.status).toBe(401);
    expect((await body(wrongPassword)).error?.code).toBe("AUTHENTICATION_FAILED");
    expect(driver.owner?.totp_secret_ciphertext).toBeNull();

    driver.owner!.active = false;
    const inactive = await composed.fetch(login(password));
    expect(inactive.status).toBe(401);
    expect((await body(inactive)).data?.otpauth_uri).toBeUndefined();
    driver.owner!.active = true;
    driver.owner!.owner = false;
    const nonOwner = await composed.fetch(login(password));
    expect(nonOwner.status).toBe(401);
    expect((await body(nonOwner)).data?.otpauth_uri).toBeUndefined();
    driver.owner!.owner = true;

    const enrollmentRequired = await composed.fetch(login(password));
    expect(enrollmentRequired.status).toBe(403);
    const denial = await body(enrollmentRequired);
    expect(denial.error?.code).toBe("TOTP_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED");
    expect(denial.data?.otpauth_uri).toEqual(expect.stringMatching(/^otpauth:\/\/totp\//));
    const uri = new URL(String(denial.data?.otpauth_uri));
    const seed = uri.searchParams.get("secret");
    expect(seed).toMatch(/^[A-Z2-7]{32,}$/);
    expect(driver.owner?.totp_secret_ciphertext).toMatch(/^aes256gcm\$/);
    expect(String(driver.owner?.totp_secret_ciphertext)).not.toContain(seed!);
    expect(await decryptTotpSecretV1(String(driver.owner?.totp_secret_ciphertext), env.ADMIN_TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY!,
      "org-acceptance", "user-acceptance")).toBe(seed);

    const confirmCode = await hotp(seed!, BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 30_000)));
    const confirmRequest = () => jsonRequest("/v1/admin/session/enrollment/confirm", "POST", {
      owner_email: "owner@example.test", password, totp_code: confirmCode,
    });
    const confirmed = await composed.fetch(confirmRequest());
    expect(confirmed.status).toBe(200);
    expect((await body(confirmed)).data).toMatchObject({ enrolled: true });
    expect(driver.owner?.totp_enrolled).toBe(true);
    const replay = await composed.fetch(confirmRequest());
    expect(replay.status).toBe(401);
    expect((await body(replay)).error?.code).toBe("AUTHENTICATION_FAILED");

    const enrolledLogin = await composed.fetch(login(password));
    expect(enrolledLogin.status).toBe(401);
    const enrolledDenial = await body(enrolledLogin);
    expect(enrolledDenial.error?.code).toBe("AUTHENTICATION_FAILED");
    expect(enrolledDenial.data?.otpauth_uri).toBeUndefined();
    expect(driver.sessions.filter((row) => row.kind === "ADMIN")).toHaveLength(0);
  }, 30_000);

  it("enrolls TOTP once, stores only ciphertext, then issues a device-bound USER session and signed LIC-001 snapshot", async () => {
    const env = await configuredBindings();
    const driver = new MemoryPgDriver();
    const password = "correct horse battery staple";
    installOwner(driver, await hashPasswordPbkdf2V1(password));
    const composed = await composeLicenseWorkerV1(env, { driver, fetch: vi.fn() });
    const loginBody = { email: "owner@example.test", password, device_id: "device-acceptance" };

    const bootstrap = await composed.fetch(jsonRequest("/v1/auth/session", "POST", loginBody));
    expect(bootstrap.status, await bootstrap.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    expect((await body(bootstrap)).data).toMatchObject({ totp_state: "ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED" });
    expect(driver.sessions.filter((row) => row.kind === "USER")).toHaveLength(0);

    const enrolled = await composed.fetch(jsonRequest("/v1/auth/session/totp/enroll", "POST", loginBody));
    expect(enrolled.status).toBe(200);
    const enrollmentData = (await body(enrolled)).data as { otpauth_uri: string };
    const uri = new URL(enrollmentData.otpauth_uri);
    const seed = uri.searchParams.get("secret");
    expect(uri.protocol).toBe("otpauth:");
    expect(uri.searchParams.get("algorithm")).toBe("SHA1");
    expect(uri.searchParams.get("period")).toBe("30");
    expect(seed).toMatch(/^[A-Z2-7]{32,}$/);
    expect(driver.owner?.totp_secret_ciphertext).toMatch(/^aes256gcm\$/);
    expect(String(driver.owner?.totp_secret_ciphertext)).not.toContain(seed!);
    expect(await decryptTotpSecretV1(String(driver.owner?.totp_secret_ciphertext), env.ADMIN_TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY!,
      "org-acceptance", "user-acceptance")).toBe(seed);
    const enrollmentSession = driver.sessions.find((row) => row.kind === "TOTP_ENROLLMENT");
    expect(enrollmentSession).toBeDefined();
    const cookie = enrolled.headers.get("set-cookie");
    expect(cookie).toMatch(/^auth_enrollment=[^;]+; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict/);
    const nowStep = BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 30_000));
    const confirmCode = await hotp(seed!, nowStep - 1n);
    const confirm = await composed.fetch(jsonRequest("/v1/auth/session/totp/confirm", "POST", { code: confirmCode },
      { Cookie: cookie!.split(";")[0]! }));
    expect(confirm.status).toBe(200);
    expect((await body(confirm)).data).toMatchObject({ totp_state: "ENROLLED" });
    expect(driver.owner?.totp_enrolled).toBe(true);
    expect(enrollmentSession?.revokedAt).not.toBeNull();
    const replayConfirm = await composed.fetch(jsonRequest("/v1/auth/session/totp/confirm", "POST", { code: confirmCode },
      { Cookie: cookie!.split(";")[0]! }));
    expect(replayConfirm.status).toBe(401);

    const currentCode = await hotp(seed!, nowStep);
    const sessionResponse = await composed.fetch(jsonRequest("/v1/auth/session", "POST", {
      ...loginBody, totp_code: currentCode,
    }));
    expect(sessionResponse.status).toBe(200);
    const result = (await body(sessionResponse)).data as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(result.totp_state).toBe("ENROLLED");
    const snapshot = result.license_snapshot as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(snapshot).toMatchObject({ orgId: "org-acceptance", deviceId: "device-acceptance",
      audience: "leviathan-desktop", signingKeyId: "key_compose_acceptance" });
    const signature = snapshot.signature as { algorithm: string; value: string };
    expect(signature.algorithm).toBe("ECDSA_P256_SHA256");
    const publicKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey("jwk", JSON.parse(env.LICENSE_VERIFY_PUBLIC_KEY_JWK!) as JsonWebKey,
      { name: "ECDSA", namedCurve: "P-256" }, false, ["verify"]);
    expect(await crypto.subtle.verify({ name: "ECDSA", hash: "SHA-256" }, publicKey,
      decodeB64Url(signature.value), canonicalLicenseSnapshotV1(snapshot as never))).toBe(true);
    const token = String(result.device_token).split(".");
    expect(token).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(decodeJsonB64Url(token[1]!)).toMatchObject({ schema_version: 1, org_id: "org-acceptance",
      device_id: "device-acceptance", licence_id: "lic_acceptance_001" });
    expect(result.expires_at_utc_ns).toBeDefined();
    const userSession = driver.sessions.find((row) => row.kind === "USER");
    expect(userSession).toBeDefined();
    expect(BigInt(String(userSession?.expiresAt)) - BigInt(String(userSession?.issuedAt))).toBe(600_000_000_000n);
    const startCipherWrite = driver.events.find((event) => /UPDATE LICENSING_USERS SET TOTP_SECRET_CIPHERTEXT/i.test(event.sql));
    const startAuditWrite = driver.events.find((event) => /AUTH\.TOTP\.ENROLLMENT\.START/i.test(event.sql));
    const confirmUserWrite = driver.events.find((event) => /UPDATE LICENSING_USERS SET TOTP_ENROLLED=TRUE/i.test(event.sql));
    const confirmAuditWrite = driver.events.find((event) => /AUTH\.TOTP\.ENROLLMENT\.CONFIRM/i.test(event.sql));
    const loginStepWrite = driver.events.find((event) => /UPDATE LICENSING_USERS SET TOTP_LAST_STEP/i.test(event.sql));
    const loginSessionWrite = driver.events.find((event) => /INSERT INTO LICENSING_ADMIN_SESSIONS/i.test(event.sql)
      && /'USER'/i.test(event.sql));
    const loginAuditWrite = driver.events.find((event) => /AUTH\.SESSION\.CREATE/i.test(event.sql));
    expect(startCipherWrite?.transactionId).not.toBeNull();
    expect(startCipherWrite?.transactionId).toBe(startAuditWrite?.transactionId);
    expect(confirmUserWrite?.transactionId).not.toBeNull();
    expect(confirmUserWrite?.transactionId).toBe(confirmAuditWrite?.transactionId);
    expect(loginStepWrite?.transactionId).not.toBeNull();
    expect(loginStepWrite?.transactionId).toBe(loginSessionWrite?.transactionId);
    expect(loginStepWrite?.transactionId).toBe(loginAuditWrite?.transactionId);
  }, 30_000);

  it("denies wrong password, unknown owner, wrong TOTP, and device mismatch without issuing sessions", async () => {
    const env = await configuredBindings();
    const driver = new MemoryPgDriver();
    const password = "correct horse battery staple";
    const seed = "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP";
    const encrypted = await encryptTotpSecretV1(seed, env.ADMIN_TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY!, "org-acceptance", "user-acceptance");
    installOwner(driver, await hashPasswordPbkdf2V1(password), { totp_enrolled: true, totp_secret_ciphertext: encrypted });
    const composed = await composeLicenseWorkerV1(env, { driver, fetch: vi.fn() });
    const base = { email: "owner@example.test", password, device_id: "device-acceptance", totp_code: "000000" };
    for (const [label, login] of [
      ["wrong password", { ...base, password: "wrong password for owner" }],
      ["unknown owner", { ...base, email: "missing@example.test" }],
      ["wrong code", base],
      ["device mismatch", { ...base, device_id: "other-device" }],
    ] as const) {
      const response = await composed.fetch(jsonRequest("/v1/auth/session", "POST", login));
      expect(response.status, label).toBe(401);
      const raw = await response.text();
      expect(raw).not.toContain(password);
      expect(raw).not.toContain("wrong password");
    }
    expect(driver.sessions.filter((row) => row.kind === "USER")).toHaveLength(0);
  }, 30_000);

  it("rolls back admin and signup business writes when their audit insert fails", async () => {
    const driver = new MemoryPgDriver();
    driver.failAudit = true;
    const key = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(32).fill(5)));
    const admin = createNeonAdminAdapterV1(driver, key);
    await expect(admin.store.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.createOrganization({ org_id: "org-rollback", display_name: "Rollback", active: true, expected_version: "0" });
      await tx.createOwnerIdentity({ org_id: "org-rollback", user_id: "user-rollback",
        email: "rollback@example.test", occurred_at_utc_ns: "1700000000000000000" });
      await tx.appendAudit({ audit_id: "audit-rollback", org_id: "org-rollback", actor_user_id: "admin-1",
        action: "CREATE", resource_type: "org", resource_id: "org-rollback", occurred_at_utc_ns: "1700000000000000000",
        outcome: "SUCCEEDED", reason: "", correlation_id: "audit-rollback" });
    })).rejects.toThrow("synthetic audit insert failure");
    expect(driver.organizations).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(driver.users).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(driver.audits).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(driver.rollbacks).toBe(1);
    const adminWrites = driver.events.filter((event) => /INSERT INTO LICENSING_(ORGANIZATIONS|USERS|AUDIT_EVENTS)/i.test(event.sql));
    expect(new Set(adminWrites.map((event) => event.transactionId)).size).toBe(1);

    const signupDriver = new MemoryPgDriver();
    signupDriver.failAudit = true;
    const signup = createNeonSignupAdapterV1(signupDriver,
      { stripe_secret_key: "sk_test_fixture", stripe_mode: "test", stripe_price_id: "price_fixture" }, vi.fn());
    await expect(signup.pending_signups.createPending({ org_name: "Rollback Org", owner_email: "rollback@example.test",
      device_id: "device-rollback", idempotency_key: "idem-rollback" })).rejects.toThrow("synthetic audit insert failure");
    expect(signupDriver.organizations).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(signupDriver.users).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(signupDriver.devices).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(signupDriver.pending).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(signupDriver.rollbacks).toBe(1);
    const signupWrites = signupDriver.events.filter((event) => /INSERT INTO LICENSING_(ORGANIZATIONS|USERS|DEVICES|PENDING_SIGNUPS|AUDIT_EVENTS)/i.test(event.sql));
    expect(new Set(signupWrites.map((event) => event.transactionId)).size).toBe(1);
    expect(signupWrites.find((event) => /INSERT INTO LICENSING_USERS/i.test(event.sql))?.sql).toMatch(/'owner'/);
  });

  it("deduplicates webhook events by the LIC-002 source_event_id inside the transaction", async () => {
    const driver = new MemoryPgDriver();
    driver.owner = { org_id: "org-webhook", user_id: "user-webhook", email: "webhook@example.test" };
    driver.pending.push({ pending_account_id: "pending-webhook", org_id: "org-webhook", status: "PENDING",
      owner_email: "webhook@example.test", device_id: "device-webhook" });
    const signup = createNeonSignupAdapterV1(driver,
      { stripe_secret_key: "sk_test_fixture", stripe_mode: "test", stripe_price_id: "price_fixture", caps_approved: true }, vi.fn());
    const event = { event_id: "evt-webhook-unique", event_type: "invoice.paid" as const,
      event_created_utc_ns: "1700000000000000000", pending_account_id: "pending-webhook", org_id: "org-webhook",
      subscription_id: "sub-webhook", customer_id: "cus-webhook", status: "ACTIVE" as const,
      term_start_utc_ns: "1700000000000000000", term_end_utc_ns: "2000000000000000000" };
    await signup.webhook_transactions.applyVerifiedEvent(event);
    await expect(signup.webhook_transactions.applyVerifiedEvent(event)).rejects.toThrow("EVENT_REPLAY");
    expect(driver.eventIds.has("evt-webhook-unique")).toBe(true);
    expect(driver.revisions.filter((row) => row.source_event_id === "evt-webhook-unique")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(driver.rollbacks).toBe(1);
  });

  it("applies ordered migrations once and does not pass the connection string to SQL or output", async () => {
    const applied = new Set<string>();
    const migrationBodies: string[] = [];
    const queried: string[] = [];
    const fakePool = {
      async connect() {
        return {
          async query<Row>(sql: string, params: unknown[] = []) {
            queried.push(sql);
            const normalized = sql.trim().toUpperCase();
            if (normalized.startsWith("SELECT 1 FROM SCHEMA_MIGRATIONS")) {
              return { rows: (applied.has(String(params[0])) ? [{ present: 1 }] : []) as Row[] };
            }
            if (normalized.startsWith("INSERT INTO SCHEMA_MIGRATIONS")) {
              applied.add(String(params[0]));
              return { rows: [] as Row[] };
            }
            if (/^-- LIC-WORKER-COMPOSE-001/i.test(sql.trim())) migrationBodies.push(sql);
            return { rows: [] as Row[] };
          },
          release() {},
        };
      },
      async end() {},
    };
    const connectionString = "postgres://synthetic-secret-must-never-be-printed.invalid/db";
    await applyMigrationsV1({ connectionString, pool: fakePool });
    const firstRunCount = migrationBodies.length;
    await applyMigrationsV1({ connectionString, pool: fakePool });
    expect(firstRunCount).toBe(1);
    expect(migrationBodies).toHaveLength(firstRunCount);
    expect([...applied]).toEqual(["001_subscription.sql", "002_no_trial.sql", "003_signup_admin.sql"]);
    expect(queried.join("\n")).not.toContain(connectionString);
  });

});
